Title: SpaceX xAI Merger Valued at $1.25 Trillion Ahead of Mega IPO - Inspirepreneur Magazine
# SpaceX xAI Merger Valued at $1.25 Trillion Ahead of Mega IPO. SpaceX is set to merge with xAI, the artificial intelligence startup founded by Elon Musk, in a deal that would value the combined entity at about $1.25 trillion, according to media reports citing people familiar with the matter. The proposed merger would combine SpaceX’s space launch and satellite internet operations with xAI’s artificial intelligence research, creating a single company spanning aerospace, communications and AI development. ## Merger Brings Together Space and AI Businesses. Under the plan, SpaceX will absorb xAI, aligning the AI firm more closely with Musk’s broader technology ecosystem. SpaceX operates the Starlink satellite network and provides launch services for commercial customers and government agencies, while xAI develops large language models and related AI systems, including the Grok chatbot. The combined valuation of roughly $1.25 trillion reflects recent private market assessments of both companies, according to the reports. At the same time, xAI’s valuation surged rapidly following funding rounds and its acquisition of the social media platform X. People familiar with the discussions said the merger is designed to simplify ownership and governance ahead of a potential public listing. An IPO at the reported valuation would place the merged entity among the most valuable technology companies globally, rivalling established public market leaders in scale. The merger highlights Musk’s strategy of integrating his businesses to support long-term technological goals. By bringing AI capabilities closer to SpaceX’s satellite and space infrastructure, the company could explore new applications such as AI-powered communications, data processing and autonomous systems. The scale of the proposed merger is likely to attract regulatory attention, particularly given SpaceX’s extensive contracts with US government agencies, including NASA and the Department of Defence. Analysts have also pointed to governance challenges, as Musk holds leadership roles across several major companies. So far, neither SpaceX nor xAI has released detailed public statements outlining governance structures or how operations will be integrated. In 2025, it acquired X, deepening Musk’s push to combine data, distribution and AI development. The merger follows earlier consolidation moves within Musk’s business portfolio aimed at streamlining operations ahead of public market access.

Title: The Business of AI: Understanding Funding Rounds and Valuation in Artificial Intelligence
# The Business of AI: Understanding Funding Rounds and Valuation in Artificial Intelligence. The Business of AI: Understanding Funding Rounds and Valuation in Artificial Intelligence. ## The Crucial Role of Valuation and Funding in AI's Ascent. Understanding how AI companies are valued and how they secure funding rounds is paramount for anyone looking to navigate or participate in this dynamic sector. This post will delve deep into the mechanics of AI funding rounds and the specific factors that influence valuation, offering practical insights into what makes an AI venture truly valuable in the eyes of the market and investors. The journey of an AI startup, much like any tech venture, typically involves a series of funding rounds, each serving a distinct purpose and attracting different types of investors. Valuation here is highly speculative, often based on the strength of the team, the novelty of the AI idea, and the perceived market potential rather than existing revenue or users. ### Series A: Proving Product-Market Fit. Once an AI company has a working MVP and demonstrates initial traction – perhaps with early users or pilot programs – it typically seeks **Series A funding**. For highly successful AI companies, late-stage funding may involve private equity firms or pre-IPO rounds, as they prepare for a potential public offering (IPO) or a major acquisition. ## The Nuances of AI Company Valuation: Beyond Traditional Metrics. AI's disruptive potential often means companies are valued not just on current revenue, but on their ability to capture a massive **Total Addressable Market (TAM)**. While revenue multiples eventually become important, early-stage AI companies might be valued more on user engagement, unique model adoption, or even the sheer computational power and efficiency of their AI. ## Challenges and Future Outlook in AI Valuation and Funding. Understanding **Valuation, Funding** in the AI sector is more than just comprehending financial terms; it's about grasping the intrinsic value of innovation, data, and human ingenuity. Unlike traditional AI systems that primarily analyze data or make predictions based on existing patterns, generative AI models create entirely new, original content.

items.raw_snippet: # Is Elon Musk trying to influence SpaceX’s valuation ahead of IPO. It looks like Elon Musk is trying to make it seem that SpaceX is more valuable than it actually is. Musk’s rocket company SpaceX has acquired xAI, the artificial intelligence firm founded by himself three years ago, in a massive, and unconventional, deal that combines the two privately held firms into a company with an astounding $1.25 trillion reported valuation and plans for a historic IPO this year. The deal, described as unconventional due to both companies being privately held and founded by the same individual, signals Musk’s ambition to integrate his ventures in aerospace and artificial intelligence under one corporate umbrella. Analysts note that the consolidation could streamline operations, accelerate research, and allow Musk to leverage cross-disciplinary technologies, from AI‑driven space exploration systems to autonomous robotics and computational simulations for aerospace applications. **READ: Elon Musk reignites row over LinkedIn’s Hoffman’s Trump ‘martyr’ remark (**. While the precise terms of the acquisition have not been publicly disclosed, the strategic implications are significant: it aligns Musk’s AI initiatives with SpaceX’s long-term space ambitions, potentially creating synergies between AI software development and spacecraft engineering. Beyond the technical and financial aspects, the merger carries symbolic weight, highlighting Musk’s continued influence over two of the most transformative industries of the 21st century. By uniting xAI with SpaceX, Musk supposedly reinforces a vision of integrated technological ecosystems, in which AI and space exploration support and amplify each other. Musk cited the potential for space-based data centers, the energy-intensive computing facilities necessary to power AI services, as one of the most important benefits of the combination, even though the concept is still unproven and largely theoretical. For Elon Musk, the merger of SpaceX and xAI represents more than just a business transaction, it is a strategic statement about his vision for the future of technology. **READ: Elon Musk explores company merger as SpaceX IPO nears (**. By bringing his aerospace and AI ventures together, Musk positions himself at the intersection of two of the most transformative industries of the 21st century, signaling his intent to shape the direction of both sectors simultaneously. items.raw_snippet: * English Content Revolut founder set to launch venture capital fund powered by artificial intelligence. # Revolut founder set to launch venture capital fund powered by artificial intelligence. Revolut founder Nik Storonsky is set to launch his own venture capital fund, powered by artificial intelligence. The new venture — dubbed QuantumLight Capital — will be worth around $200 million, with funds supplied by Storonsky and other investors, Forbes reported on Tuesday. “We are built as a technology company by a team of tech unicorn founders, quant traders, AI scientists and engineers,” the QuantumLight website states. The fund will identify investment opportunities using a machine called Aleph as its “proprietary quantitative decision engine.”. According to Forbes, QuantumLight will be focused mainly on Series B and Series C rounds, based on software which eliminates “human judgement.” Storonsky argues that the model is designed to eliminate the clubby world of venture capital, where decisions are made through a crowd mentality. The neobank founder has spent the last year building a team of data scientists and engineers to browse LinkedIn, corporate filings and other public databases in order to identify fast-growing startups. He will also hire in a CEO to head up the fund, according to the Forbes report. The move comes at a time of global expansion for Revolut. In recent months it has acquired banking licenses in at least 10 European countries as it has touted adding new products to it roster, such as home loans and buy-now-pay-later. It has also tussled with UK regulators over anti-money laundering requirements for its crypto products. It is still on the Financial Conduct Authority’s so-called temporary register, alongside crypto custodian Copper and three other firms. The register is a stopgap measure the FCA created after missing an earlier deadline to green-light companies’ operations. Their fate remains uncertain, but without full registration they could in theory be forced to stop crypto-related activities in the UK. ##### Relative altcoin weakness masks early internal rotation. ##### Block Scholes crypto options data comes to Bloomberg terminal to ‘Build Bridge’ for financial institutions. ##### China’s solar energy set to overtake coal, but new coal rush threatens ‘historic’ shift.

Title: NEAR to Hire Artificial-Intelligence Engineers as Part of AI Roadmap
# NEAR to Hire Artificial-Intelligence Engineers as Part of AI Roadmap. ## The company will begin its AI initiative in the next 3-6 months according to a document reviewed by CoinDesk. Updated Apr 10, 2024, 2:52 p.m. Published Apr 10, 2024, 2:50 p.m. Illia Polosukhin, Co-Founder, NEAR Protocol (Stephen Lovekin/Shutterstock/CoinDesk). Illia Polosukhin, Co-Founder, NEAR Protocol (Stephen Lovekin/Shutterstock/CoinDesk). Layer-1, NEAR, will hire artificial-intelligence (AI) engineers as part of its 3-6 month roadmap to building user-owned AI. According to a deck reviewed by CoinDesk, the company is planning to hire AI engineers “soon,” and its product team is working to plan AI workstreams over a 3-6 month transition phase. This comes as the intersection between AI and blockchain continues to be a hot topic, with NEAR attempting to position itself at the forefront. Polosukhin was on a panel at Nivida’s conference titled "Transforming AI" last month, and saw its token NEAR double in price in anticipation of the event. The company is well seasoned in terms of AI expertise, Polosukhin is an artificial intelligence researcher and software engineer that co-built the ‘Transformer’ architecture. NEAR will use near.ai for surfacing AI information and will make an external announcement in May, according to the slide show. The layer-1 says it believes it is uniquely positioned to make AI open source, given its not-for-profit and decentralized nature. NEAR has been pushing its “chain abstraction,” narrative over the past few months, which aims to tackle the user experience in crypto by simplifying the hurdles that exist in a multichain environment. AI will help deliver NEAR’s core vision by accelerating development & ease of use, according to the deck viewed by CoinDesk. Most crypto privacy models weaken as blockchain data grows. This report provides a comprehensive comparison of all five major crypto privacy architectures and a framework for evaluating which models remain durable as AI capabilities improve.
